title: Leica CSX8 Rugged Android Tablet
summary:
The CSX8 is the tablet at the centre of the Leica X-PAD workflow: a rugged 8-inch Android 12 tablet built to run X-PAD and drive a GNSS receiver or a total station through a full day of survey work.

It is built for the job site rather than the office. The 8-inch WUXGA screen is sunlight readable at 500 nits under Corning Gorilla Glass 5, and fourteen physical buttons, six of them user-programmable, keep the software one tap away instead of buried in menus. It takes a 1.5 metre drop onto marble, is rated IP66 and IP68, and works from -20 to +60 degrees C.

It stays connected and stays powered. Dual-frequency GNSS is built in, along with 5G and LTE, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5.1, USB-A and USB-C. A 32 megapixel rear camera with dual flash and an 8 megapixel front camera cover the imaging and video work, and the exchangeable 8200 mAh battery carries a full day, with up to 15 hours of operation. At 730 g and 19.5 mm thick it is a tablet you can hold on a pole or carry in the same bag as the instrument.

Because it runs X-PAD, one interface and one data format carry across the instrument you are holding. A GS11 GNSS smart antenna, a GS05, a TS13 robotic total station: the same workflows, the same HeXML data, the same office companion in X-PAD Fusion.
specs: Operating system: Android 12 with Google Mobile Services
Processor: Qualcomm SM4350AC octa-core 2.2 GHz, 8 GB LPDDR4x RAM, 256 GB UFS 2.2 storage
Display: 8-inch widescreen WUXGA 1920 x 1200, 500 nits, sunlight readable, Corning Gorilla Glass 5, 10-finger multitouch and USI 2.0 active stylus support
Keyboard and buttons: 14 physical buttons, dedicated touchscreen lock button, six user and software definable function keys
GNSS: dual-frequency receiver supporting BeiDou, Galileo, GLONASS, NavIC, GPS and QZSS
Camera: 32 MP autofocus rear camera with dual flash, 8 MP fixed focus front camera
Connectivity: 5G FR1, LTE, WCDMA, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, Bluetooth 5.1
Ports: USB 2.0 Type-A (OTG), USB 3.2 Type-C (OTG), microSD card slot
Power: replaceable 8200 mAh Li-Ion battery, up to 15 hours operating time
Size: 250 x 156 x 19.5 mm, 730 g with battery
Environmental: IP66 and IP68, 1.5 m drop resistant on marble (IEC 60068-2-31), operating -20 to +60 degrees C, storage -40 to +70 degrees C, MIL-STD-810H
accessories: Leica X-PAD field software, installed on the tablet
Leica GS11 or GS05 GNSS smart antenna
GeoMax Zenith 60 GNSS smart antenna, supported by X-PAD
Leica TS13 robotic total station, for a hybrid GNSS and total station setup where the total station tracks a prism on the antenna
Spare 8200 mAh Li-Ion battery with USB-C charging cable and power adapter
SIM card for LTE data transfer
